in_hebrew.name: Icken
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Icken הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'ikos' meaning 'equal' or 'same'. Icken was a common name among early Christians, symbolizing the unity and equality in Christ.

in_latin.name: Icken
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Power, strength
